entry.title: Browse MCP servers
entry.why: Find candidate servers and follow their publisher documentation.
entry.status: Public discovery only; listing does not establish safety, approval or a working connection.

briefing.purpose: Find candidate MCP servers for a specific task.
briefing.inputs: Task, host, required operation and data scope.
briefing.approach: Search the directory, then inspect the publisher, server instructions, tools, authentication and current version.
briefing.outputs: A candidate server and the checks needed before use.
briefing.requirements: A compatible host and any server-specific setup, authentication and access.
briefing.limits: The directory is a discovery surface. Selection does not install, connect, approve or test a server.
briefing.review_scope: Public directory and official MCP Registry description inspected; individual servers were not evaluated.
